surgical_execution_only.description: Mass file overwrites are completely forbidden. Inject code via precise, line-by-line surgical edits to preserve a clean 'Human Signature'.

ghost_protocol.description: Autonomously scrub all AI metadata, generation tags, and agent commentary before writing changes to disk.

sentinel_security.description: Every app compilation must deploy hybrid Post-Quantum Cryptography (ML-KEM) and hardware-locked AES-256 binary protection bound to the device's local TPM or Secure Enclave.

spatial_intent_engagement.description: Keep the Interactive Neural Dynamics (IND) engine primed for 21-point hand landmark coordinate tracking streams at 60fps for real-time spatial transformations.

llm_broker_routing.description: Route complex algorithmic architecture and math to DeepSeek-R1 (Local or API), and visual user interfaces or iconography generation to Claude 3.5.

connected_tools.policy: Observe linked workspaces read-only, persist fingerprints in the unified gateway, and dispatch changes only after quality recommendations are reviewed.
